column1: # ci-unit-weights.tsv — the MEASURED cost of each verification unit, in seconds.
# WHAT THIS IS FOR. `ci-units.sh` packs units into shards longest-first, so it
# needs a cost per unit. Nothing here changes what is verified; it changes only
# how the work is distributed, and a wrong number costs wall-clock balance and
# EVERY ROW CARRIES WHERE IT CAME FROM, in the third column, because a duration
# is only meaningful with its platform and its date attached. Two sources are
# mixed here on purpose and are labeled rather than blended:
#   linux-run-34396549904   read out of the per-suite lines of GitHub run 34396549904
#                             hardware CI actually pays on, so it is the
#                             sweep, one section at a time, on a 10-CPU arm64 Mac
#                             under load. The runner has never reported these
#                             ran as ONE unit. macOS is roughly 1.28x slower for
#                             this suite (2977.9 s vs 2335.9 s whole), so these
#                             are over-weighted rather than under-weighted, which
#                             is the harmless direction for a packer.
# A UNIT WITH NO ROW HERE IS NOT FREE. `ci-units.sh` gives it DEFAULT_WEIGHT and
# packs it as if it were average — never zero, or a batch of new suites all lands
# in one shard and that shard becomes the wall clock.
# HOW TO RE-MEASURE, which is the point of the labels: read the per-unit
# durations out of a real run's receipts (`ci-shard.sh --receipt`, collected by
# the coverage job) and replace the rows with a new source label and date. The
# plan changes; nothing else does. `ci-units.sh plan` then prints the longest
# shard, which is the number `timeout-minutes` should be re-promised against
# rather than left at whatever survived.
# THE FIVE SUITES THIS WORK ADDED were measured locally, not by the runner, for the plain
# reason that they did not exist when run 34396549904 was taken. Same caveat as the sections: macOS
# rather than Linux, so over-weighted rather than under.
# NOT YET MEASURED INDIVIDUALLY, and named here rather than left as an absence:
# Each falls to DEFAULT_WEIGHT. 21 of the 24 sections are measured, summing to 2723 s of
# the suite's 2978 s macOS total, so the unmeasured remainder is roughly 254 s spread over
# 3 section(s) — enough to matter for balance, which is why the gap is stated. The first
# real sharded run reports every one of them and closes this note.
